title: Query Parameters
definition: Unlike route parameters which are part of the URL path itself, query parameters are appended to the end of the URL after a `?` symbol (e.g., `/search?keyword=express&sort=asc`). They are typically used for optional data like filtering, sorting, or pagination. Express automatically parses these and places them in the `req.query` object.
